# Installed by hipdnn-superbuild-ci.yml into the venv it passes as
# -DPython3_EXECUTABLE, before "Configure superbuild"; that step explains why the
# ordering matters for pytest.
#
# pytest -- the descriptor-packaging suite, and the frontend wheel tests.
# build  -- the PEP 517 frontend that packs the frontend wheel.
# numpy  -- imported by frontend_wheel_package/tests, not by the build.
# jsonschema -- the descriptor-packaging suite validates UHD sidecars against
#               uhd.schema.json; without it those checks skip.
# uhd_gen's requirements -- its training stack (LightGBM, pandas, pyarrow, ...), so the
#               uhd_gen and skill-script suites and TestUhdGenArtifact run rather than skip.
#
# The versions are pinned by constraints-hipdnn-superbuild-ci.txt.
-c constraints-hipdnn-superbuild-ci.txt
pytest
build
numpy
jsonschema
-r ../projects/hipdnn/tools/uhd_gen/requirements.txt
